steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park and switch the vehicle ON so the center display comes up.
On the home screen, select Information, then select Vehicle Status Monitor.
Open the vehicle maintenance settings and select Reset Oil Change Distance.
If the other scheduled service was also done, select Reset Service Interval to reset the next service date and distance.
oil.note: The CX-50 owner's manual sends you to the Information section of the separate Mazda Connect owner's manual for this; the steps come from the 2024 US edition of that manual, which does not spell out every screen. Reset after every oil change, even if the wrench light has not come on.
